title: CMake+Windows: Add a native Asciidoctor package
description:
Ruby binaries for Windows are available as plain 7-zip archives, so use
that to create an Asciidoctor bundle for Windows. Use FetchArtifacts to
download Asciidoctor and DocBook, and note that we should migrate the
rest of win-setup.ps1 to FetchArtifacts.

commits_data.title: CMake+Windows: Add a native Asciidoctor package
commits_data.message:
CMake+Windows: Add a native Asciidoctor package

Ruby binaries for Windows are available as plain 7-zip archives, so use
that to create an Asciidoctor bundle for Windows. Use FetchArtifacts to
download Asciidoctor and DocBook, and note that we should migrate the
rest of win-setup.ps1 to FetchArtifacts.
